Bill.BriefDescription: Enacting the American heritage act for Washington state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to history and heritage education; adding a newsection to chapter 28A.320 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: School districts may not censor or restrict instruction in UnitedStates or Washington state history or heritage based on religiousreferences in original source documents, writings, speeches,proclamations, or records such as: (1) The Mayflower compact; (2) The Declaration of Independence; (3) The Constitution of the United States; (4) The Washington state Constitution; (5) The preambles and constitutions of other states within theUnited States; (6) The Northwest Ordinance of 1787; (7) The Federalist Papers; (8) The Pledge of Allegiance; (9) The national anthem; p. 1 HB 2377 (10) George Washington's farewell address to the nation; (11) Abraham Lincoln's Gettysburg address; (12) United States' presidential proclamations; and (13) Patrick Henry's speeches.
This act may be known and cited as theAmerican heritage act for Washington state.
